name: link_default_id
description: Generate product URLs exactly as provided by the data source, with size selection when applicable.
description_pl: Generuje linki feedu z domyślnym identyfikatorem IdoSell do adresów produktów które wskazuje źródło danych.
notes: Produces product URLs from card/@url or ../../card/@url without trimming the source address, and appends size selection for multiple sizes.
